info.title: Token Controller API
info.description: The versioned REST API of Token Controller. Everything the web app does goes through it. See docs.tokencontroller.com/reference/api.

get.summary:
Your API tokens and CLI tokens, or every one in the organization for a
org manager.

post.summary:
Create an API token. Anyone can create service and read tokens for
themselves; only an org manager creates the organization token.

delete.summary: Revoke an API token or a CLI token: your own, or any as an org manager.

post.summary:
Hand a service token over to another member, for example when its
creator leaves. Only future token entries follow. Its owner or a
org manager can do this.

get.summary: Attribute names with their values.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

post.summary: Add an attribute name, such as `guild`. Org managers only.

Add an attribute value, or change one: the same key again supersedes
the earlier record. Needs assign on the value with its defaults; an
org manager holds it everywhere.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The attribute name, such as `team`

get.summary: The bill sources the organization connected. Org managers only.

post.summary:
Connect a bill source with an admin key. Org managers only. The first
pull starts right away and loads the current and the previous month.

delete.summary:
Disconnect a bill source. Org managers only. Its bills stay, and stop
updating.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The bill connection

post.summary:
Pull a bill source's bills now instead of at its next daily pull.
Org managers only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The bill connection

202.description: The pull starts within a minute

get.summary: The bills in force, newest range first, each with its reconciliation.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The moment to look back to; default now.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only bills whose range starts on or after this day.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only bills whose range ends on or before this day.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only this provider.

parameters.name: reversed
parameters.description: `true` to include reversed bills.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The bills, as JSON or CSV

403.description: Only an org manager can read bills

post.summary: Send a bill for a date range.
post.description:
Writes a bill event when the figures differ from the bill in force for
the provider and range, reversing that one, and answers 200 with the
unchanged bill when they do not. Org managers only.

200.description: The same figures were already stored

403.description: Only an org manager can send bills

post.summary:
Upload a CSV bill file. Every bill in it is checked before any is
stored, so a file with a problem saves nothing. Each bill becomes a bill
event when its figures differ from the bill in force. Org managers
only.

parameters.name: cloud
parameters.description:
The cloud whose own cost export this is: `bedrock`, `vertex` or
`foundry`. Left out, the file is in the bill schema's columns.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month a cloud's export is the bill for, such as `2026-03`.

400.description: The file has a problem; nothing was saved

403.description: Only an org manager can upload bills

post.summary:
Read a CSV bill file and show the bills it holds, or the first problem
in it with its row and column. Saves nothing. Org managers only.

parameters.name: cloud
parameters.description:
The cloud whose own cost export this is: `bedrock`, `vertex` or
`foundry`. Left out, the file is in the bill schema's columns.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month a cloud's export is the bill for, such as `2026-03`.

403.description: Only an org manager can upload bills

get.summary: One bill and the bills it restated, oldest first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The bill event's id

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The bill and the ones it restated, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: The organization's cutoff.

post.summary: Move the cutoff. Org managers only. Moving it back is allowed.

Ask any estimator for an estimate: the classifier from `work` and the
history of every tag value, or yourself by sending `median` and, if you
like, `distribution`. Any token can ask. Needs plan on the tag set
when one is given.

409.description: No classifier is set up; send a median

get.summary: An estimate with the cost of its tag set and the labelled deviation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The estimate's id

post.summary:
Make an estimate the plan for its tag set. Accepting another one later
supersedes it. Needs plan on the tag set.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The estimate's id

get.summary: The log itself, in order, inside what the caller may view.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: One kind only, such as `split` or `tag value`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many events, the latest last. Default 500.

get.summary:
The whole log as a zip of JSON files, one per kind of record, plus the
price table rows in force and the grants. Org managers only. Reading it
back as of any date gives the same figures the service shows.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

get.summary:
The grants in force. Everyone sees their own; whoever holds grant on a
filter sees the grants inside it; org managers see all.

parameters.name: person
parameters.description: One person's grants, by email.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; default today.

post.summary:
Hand a capability to someone for a filter inside your own: view, assign,
approve, plan or grant. A new grant for the same person and capability
supersedes the old one.

get.summary: Is the service up and can it reach its database?

post.summary:
OTLP logs: one model call per event, for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini
CLI and Cursor. Takes the organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportLogsServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

post.summary:
OTLP metrics: accepted and not counted, because the events already count
every model call. Takes the organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportMetricsServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

post.summary:
OTLP traces: one model call per chat span, for Copilot CLI. Takes the
organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

get.summary:
What an invite link is for, before the person signs in: the page fills
in the email and asks for a sign-in link.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The part after /i/ in the invite link

post.summary: The MCP endpoint. Send JSON-RPC messages with a read token or a session.

requestBody.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 message of the Model Context Protocol

get.summary: The signed-in person and their organization.

What the CLI needs to split sessions like the service does: the
organization's rules, the tag names and the values you may see, your
own rules and attributes, and the price table.
Your own rules, in the order they run.

put.summary:
Replace your own rules. They run after the organization's, on your
messages only, and back over your unassigned messages since the
cutoff.

get.summary: Everyone in the organization.

post.summary:
Invite someone by email. They get a link that signs them in. Org
managers only.

409.description: Already a member, or the member limit is reached

delete.summary:
Remove a member. They can no longer sign in; their past messages keep
them as their person, and their service tokens wait for a new owner.
Org managers only.

409.description: The organization would have no org manager

patch.summary:
Change a member's name, email, role or filters. A new role or new
filters replace the grants the old ones gave. Org managers only.

409.description: The organization would have no org manager

put.summary:
Grant a people manager the filters they view, assign, approve and plan
on, such as `{"team": "web"}` and `{"client": "acme"}`. Replaces their
filters. Org managers only.

post.summary:
Send the invite mail again to someone who has not signed in yet. Org
managers only.

get.summary:
Messages with their cost, parts, tags, facts and where they stand in
submit and approval, inside what you may view. Newest first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: the beginning.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: the end.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read. Default today.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter, such as `client:acme,team:web`.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: `true` shows approved messages only.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: One session.

parameters.name: unassigned
parameters.description:
Only messages that still have no feature and no project:
organization overhead, the check list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, newest first. Default 200.

get.summary: The organization's settings.

patch.summary: Change the organization's settings. Org managers only.

get.summary: The organization's member count and member limit.

post.summary:
Put an attribute on a person from a date, such as `team: web` from
1 April. The person keeps the earlier value for earlier days. Needs
assign on the value with its defaults.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The member's id

get.summary: The rows in force: the managed table with your own rows and overrides.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read. Default today.

post.summary:
Add a row of your own, for a model the managed table lacks or a price
you negotiated: the same provider, model, kind and valid-from date as a
managed row overrides it. Org managers only. A wrong row is reversed,
never edited.

409.description: The same row is already in force

get.summary:
Each bill against the cost of its provider's messages in its range, with
the line no message explains. Org managers only.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The moment to look back to; default now.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only this provider.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: One row per bill in force

403.description: Only an org manager can read the reconciliation

get.summary:
`C(F, w)`: the cost of a filter over a range, grouped by any tag or
attribute name. Answers inside the caller's view grants.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The moment up to which the log is read; default now.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description:
A tag or attribute name, or `person`, `label`, `agent_harness`,
`agent_name`, `model` or `day`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter, such as `client:acme,team:web`.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: `true` shows approved messages only.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show money in another currency, such as `EUR`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `money` (the default) or `share`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

get.summary:
Plan, cost and deviation per value of the grouping, with labels from
the classifier where one is set up. Groupings other than a tag or
attribute name or `person` have no plan.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The moment up to which the log is read; default now.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description:
A tag or attribute name, or `person`, `label`, `agent_harness`,
`agent_name`, `model` or `day`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter, such as `client:acme,team:web`.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: `true` shows approved messages only.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show money in another currency, such as `EUR`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `money` (the default) or `share`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

get.summary:
The forecast of the filter for the next range: `from` and `to` name the
range ahead; the cost per day over the three ranges of that length
before it, times its days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in UTC.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The moment up to which the log is read; default now.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description:
A tag or attribute name, or `person`, `label`, `agent_harness`,
`agent_name`, `model` or `day`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter, such as `client:acme,team:web`.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: `true` shows approved messages only.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show money in another currency, such as `EUR`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `money` (the default) or `share`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: The saved reports of the organization.

post.summary:
Save a filter, grouping and range as a report. Reverse it through
`POST /reversals` with its id.

Reverse any event by id, as if it had never been recorded. The event
stays in the log. Whoever recorded it, whoever holds the capability it
took on its filter, or an org manager. A saved report is reversed the
same way.

get.summary: The organization's rules and your own, in the order they run.

post.summary:
Add an organization rule. It runs before everyone's personal rules, on
arrival and back over unassigned messages since the cutoff. Needs
assign on the tag it sets.

get.summary:
Sessions: their messages added up, with the cost by tag set, the
summary and the facts. Newest first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: the beginning.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default: the end.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read. Default today.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter, such as `client:acme,team:web`.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: `true` shows approved messages only.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: One session.

parameters.name: unassigned
parameters.description:
Only messages that still have no feature and no project:
organization overhead, the check list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many, newest first. Default 200.

get.summary: The shares in force whose project the caller may view.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

post.summary:
A person's share of a project's plan between two dates. Needs plan on
the project. Shares may add up to more than 1; the sum is shown.
Send a sign-in link to a member.
post.description:
Always answers 202, so nobody learns whether an address is a member. An
address that belongs to no organization gets a mail that says so, with a
link to create one.

202.description: A mail is on its way

429.description: Too many links for this address

get.summary: The page a sign-in link opens: a "Sign in" button that posts the link.

200.description: The page with the Sign in button

410.description: The link was used, has expired or never existed

post.summary: Use a sign-in link: the form on the link's page posts here.
post.description:
A browser gets its session cookie and goes to the web app, after a
sign-up to its first steps. A local tool's link only marks the link
used; the tool collects its session with `POST /sign-in/poll`.

200.description: A local tool is signed in

303.description: Signed in; on to the web app

410.description: The link was used, has expired or never existed

post.summary: Collect a local tool's session after the person used the link.

200.description: Signed in. The session token comes only once

202.description: The link was not used yet; ask again in a few seconds

410.description: The link expired, or the session was already collected

get.summary:
The ways to sign in besides the magic link, for the buttons on the
sign-in page. Empty on the open edition.

post.summary: Sign out: ends the session in the cookie or the bearer token.
Create an organization and email its first org manager a link.
post.description:
The organization exists once the link is used, in any browser. An
address that is already a member gets an ordinary sign-in link instead:
one account belongs to one organization.

202.description: A mail is on its way

400.description: Not an email address, no name, or not a currency

429.description: Too many links for this address

get.summary:
The address behind the link in the "no account" mail, for the web app's
sign-up form. Reading it uses nothing up.

410.description: The link was used, has expired, or cannot create an organization

post.summary:
Create an organization with the link from the "no account" mail. The
founder is signed in at once: the answer sets the session cookie, and
no second mail goes out.

204.description: Created and signed in; the session cookie is set

400.description: No name, or not a currency

410.description: The link was used, has expired, or cannot create an organization

post.summary:
Split a session, or one message of it. Your own, or with assign on a
filter the session is in. Supersedes the earlier split on the same
target.

get.summary: The state of every part status.tokencontroller.com shows.

Submissions you may see: your own, and those with messages inside a
filter you view.

parameters.name: person
parameters.description: One person, by email.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read. Default today.

post.summary:
Submit your messages since your last submit, up to today. An empty
submit says there was nothing to add.

Approve a submission. Needs approve on a filter its messages are in,
never your own.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The submit event's id

post.summary:
Reject a submission with a reason. It goes back to its person's check
list.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The submit event's id

get.summary:
The open requests to submit: those whose day is today or later, with
whether you are done.

post.summary:
Ask everyone to submit by a day, the way finance asks for timesheets
before month end. Each person who has not submitted gets one email.
Org managers only.

get.summary: Tag names with their values. Values are those the caller may view.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date up to which the log is read, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

post.summary: Add a tag name, such as `purpose`. Org managers only.

delete.summary:
Remove a tag name you added. The built-in names stay; values on record
stay in the log. Org managers only.

post.summary:
Add a tag value, or change one: the same key again supersedes the
earlier record. Needs assign on the value's tags with their defaults,
such as `project: shop, client: acme`; an org manager holds it
everywhere.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The tag name, such as `feature`

get.summary: The ticket systems the organization connected.

post.summary:
Connect a ticket system with an API token. Org managers only. The first
sync starts right away; whoever connects a ticket system answers for
that data flow.

400.description: The address or the token is not usable

delete.summary:
Disconnect a ticket system. Org managers only. Its features stay, and
stop syncing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket system

put.summary:
Set the sync map: which Jira projects feed which project tag values,
replacing the earlier map. Org managers only. A sync starts right away.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket system

400.description: A project is unknown or mapped twice

get.summary:
The projects the ticket system shows the token, to map. Org managers
only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket system

400.description: The ticket system refused the token or could not be read

post.summary:
Sync a ticket system now, without waiting for its 15 minutes. Org
managers only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ticket system

202.description: The sync starts within a minute

post.summary:
Report token entries: one message or session record, or a list. The
person of every message is the token's creator, or you when signed in.
Each becomes a message event; a message sent again with the same
session id and message id is the same record, and an entry with a
`local_id` seen before adds nothing. The answer carries each entry's
cost, label and the tags that are no value on record.

400.description: A token entry breaks the schema; nothing was stored

post.summary:
Import a CSV file of token entries as your own messages. Every row must
be readable; otherwise nothing is saved.

400.description: A row cannot be read; nothing was saved

post.summary:
Read a CSV file of token entries and show what it holds, with the
problem in each row that cannot be read. Saves nothing.

400.description: The file as a whole cannot be read

Accepted.description: An accept as the API shows it.

ApiToken.description: An API token as lists show it, without its secret.

needs_owner.description:
The person left the organization. A service token in this state
needs a new owner; its token entries show as an error until then.

person_id.description:
The person it belongs to: for a service token, the agent manager of
everything it reports.

shown_prefix.description: The start of the token, such as `tc_svc_3f9a`.

AttributeNameView.description: An attribute name with its values.

built_in.description: `team`, `department` and `location` are built in and stay.

defaults.description: The attributes this value brings, such as `{"department": "engineering"}` on a team.

id.description: The event id of the record.

BandView.description: One band of a distribution as the API writes it.

p.description: The chance of the band, as a fraction such as `0.31`.

up_to.description: The band's upper end in US dollars, or `null` for the last band.

BillApi.description: The provider API a bill connection pulls from.

BillConnectionView.description:
A connected bill source, as the web app shows it. The key is never sent
back.

key_hint.description: The key's last characters, to tell keys apart.

BillCsvBill.description: One bill as the file holds it.

lines.description: How many lines a cloud's export was summed from.

BillCsvPreview.description: What a CSV file holds, before anything is saved.

bills.description: The bills the file holds; empty when there is a problem.

oneOf.description: The first problem found. Nothing can be uploaded until it is fixed.

BillCsvProblem.description: What is wrong with the file, and where.

column.description: The column as the file names it.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

row.description: The line in the file, counting the header as line 1.

bills.description: Each bill in the file as it now stands.

changed.description:
How many of them became a new bill event; the rest were already
stored with the same figures.

BillInput.description:
A bill as the bills endpoint and the web app send it (docs: Reference >
Bill schema). Amounts are decimal strings in `currency`.

exchange_rate.description:
To the organization's reporting currency, at the bill's last day.
Left out, Token Controller fills it in.

from.description: The first day the bill covers, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

to.description: The last day the bill covers, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

typed_in.description: Typed in by hand in the web app, rather than sent by a program.

BillSource.description: How a bill reached Token Controller.

BillView.description: A bill as the API shows it.

exchange_rate.description:
To the reporting currency; `null` until a rate for the bill's last
day is known.

exchange_rate_given.description:
Whether the rate came with the bill, rather than from the reference
rates.

final.description: Whether the provider will no longer change these figures.

oneOf.description:
The bill against its messages; `null` for a reversed bill, or when
no rate to USD is known.

reversed_by.description:
The reversal that replaced this bill, when a later bill restated
it.

Check.description: Whether one part of the service works.

Component.description: One part of the service, as status.tokencontroller.com lists them.

last_success_at.description: For a job: when it last succeeded.

ConnectionStatus.description: How a connection's last pull or sync went.

Context.description: What a local tool needs to split sessions like the service does.

cutoff.description: The cutoff, `YYYY-MM-DD`, if one was set.

price_table.description: The price table rows in force.

rules.description: The organization's rules and your own, in the order they run.

tag_values.description: The tag values you may view.

count_errors.description:
Messages in the filter and range with no counts; their cost is not
in the total.

unknown_models.description: Models in the filter and range with no price row.

CostRow.description: One row of the cost report.

key.description: The value of the grouping, or `null` for lines without it.

share.description: The row's share of the total, a decimal fraction.

token.description: The token itself. Store it now; it is never shown again.

CreatedApiToken.description: A token just created: the only time its secret is shown.

CsvPreview.description: What a CSV file holds, before anything is saved.

problems.description: The rows that cannot, with what is wrong in each.

CutoffView.description: The cutoff as the API shows it.

cutoff.description:
The cutoff date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` when none was set: every
figure is live.

frozen_as_of.description:
The moment the frozen figures are as of: the start of the cutoff
date in UTC.

DeviationRow.description: One row of the deviation report.

deviation.description: Plan minus cost; positive is favourable.

plan.description: `P(F, w)`, or `null` when nothing is planned.

EntrySplit.description: One part of a split: a fraction, or exactly these messages.

fraction.description:
The part's fraction, as a number or a decimal string such as `"0.6"`.
The fractions add up to 1.

message_ids.description: Instead of a fraction: the messages this part covers, exactly.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain English.

EstimateView.description: An estimate as the API shows it.

accepted.description: Whether this estimate is the accepted plan for its tag set.

amount.description: The plan amount: the median with the markup inside.

cost.description: The cost of its tag set over its range so far.

deviation.description: Plan minus cost, where accepted. Positive is favourable.

estimator.description: Who made it: `classifier`, or the person's email.

id.description: The estimate's event id, such as `est_4k2q9w`.

median.description: The median in US dollars, markup inside.

EventView.description:
One event as `GET /events` and the raw export write it: the core's
own JSON, so a reader folds it back to the same figures.

kind.description: The kind in the words of the docs: `message`, `bill`, `tag value`, …

record.description: The record, tagged with its kind, as the core crate writes it.

recorded_by.description: The person who recorded it, by email, where a person did.

supersedes.description: The older event this one replaces, if any.

ExternalProject.description: A project in a ticket system, to map onto a project tag value.

key.description: What [`fetch_updated`] takes: the Jira Cloud project key (`KD`).

Facts.description: Facts about the session. All optional.

result.description: Where the result is, such as the pull request's URL.

ForecastReport.description:
The forecast report: the cost per day over the past windows times the
days of the next range.

ForecastRow.description: One row of the forecast report.

GrantView.description: One grant as the API shows it.

from_role.description: Whether a role gave it, rather than `POST /grants`.

id.description: The grant's event id; reverse it to take the grant away.

HandOver.description:
Move a service token to another person, who becomes the agent manager
of its future token entries.

Health.description: The answer of the health endpoint.

edition.description: `open`, or the edition the Enterprise plan build reports.

InviteView.description: What an invite link shows before sign-in.

email.description: The address the invite went to; sign in with it.

Invited.description: A member who was just invited, and the link they got by mail.

invite_url.description: Opens sign-in with the email filled in; `tc connect` takes it too.

Kind.description: Whether a name is a tag name or an attribute name.

LinkSent.description: The same answer whether or not the address belongs to anyone.

poll_token.description: For a local tool: pass it to `POST /sign-in/poll`.

LinkToken.description: The token in a sign-in link.

Manages.description:
What the founder manages. It picks the first steps the web app shows
after sign-up.

Mapping.description:
One row of the sync map: a Jira project and the project tag value its
issues get as default.

external.description:
The Jira project key, as `GET /ticket-systems/{id}/projects` lists
them.

external_name.description: Its name. Optional when mapping; the key stands in.

fields.description:
The fields copied onto each feature, from `title`, `description`,
`type`, `status`, `parent` and `assignee`. Left out, all of them.

project.description: The key of the project tag value.

credential.description: `session` for a person, `read` for a read token.

org_manager_notice.description:
For org managers only: a notice to show on every page, such as an
Enterprise plan renewal. `null` when there is none.

MemberChange.description: A change to a member. Fields left out stay as they are.

email.description: The address they sign in with. It must not belong to anyone else.

filters.description:
For a people manager: the filters to grant the role on. Replaces
the earlier filters.

oneOf.description: A new role replaces the grants of the old one.

MemberLimitView.description:
How many members the organization has and may have (docs: Plans and
limits).

member_limit.description:
The most members the organization may have, such as a hosted plan's.
`null` when there is no limit, as on the open build.

members.description:
Everyone invited or joined who has not left. Every member counts the
same, whatever their role.

message.description:
What an invite past the limit is refused with, such as "This instance
allows no more members." `null` when there is no limit.

MemberView.description: A member as the API shows them.

email.description:
The address they sign in with: the tag value `person` on their
messages.

filters.description:
For a people manager: the filters their role was granted on, such as
`{"team": "web"}` or `{"client": "acme"}`.

MessageList.description: A message list with its as-of moment.

MessageView.description: One message as the API shows it.

cost.description:
`C(e)` in US dollars, or `null` with a cost label other than
`priced`.

NameView.description: A tag or attribute name on the organization's list.

NewAttributeValue.description: A new attribute value, or a change to one.

key.description:
An admin key of the provider's organization: an Enterprise Analytics
API key, a Console admin key or an `OpenAI` admin key.

NewEstimate.description: Ask for an estimate, or type one.

context.description: Anything that helps the estimator, such as the cost of earlier work.

distribution.description: Type the bands yourself. They add up to 1.

from.description: The first day of the work, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

markup_percent.description: Overhead inside the amount, such as `15`.

median.description: Type the median yourself instead of asking the classifier.

tags.description: The tag set the estimate is for, such as `{"feature": "KD-1"}`.

to.description:
The last day of the work, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default 30 days after
`from`.

work.description: The description: a prompt, a spec, a feature or acceptance criteria.

filter.description: The filter; empty is the whole organization.

person.description: The person, by email. A member of the organization.

oneOf.description: Their attributes, such as `{"team": "web"}`; each a value on record.

filters.description: For a people manager: the filters to grant the role on.

NewMessage.description: One model call of a session record.

message_id.description: The agent harness's id for this call, unique within the session.

model.description: The model of this call, when it differs from the session's.

reported_cost.description: The agent's own cost figure for this call, in US dollars.

name.description: Lower-case letters, digits, `-` and `_`, up to 40 characters.

NewOrganization.description:
The organization a sign-up creates, with the answers to the sign-up
questions.

oneOf.description: Picks the first steps the web app shows after sign-up.

name.description: Your own name, as your colleagues will see it. Can be set later.

reporting_currency.description:
The one currency the organization computes in, such as `EUR`. Left
out, it is `USD`.

NewPersonAttribute.description: An attribute on a person from a date.

from.description:
The first day it holds, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Left out, it holds for every
day.

NewPriceRow.description: A new row of the organization's own.

price_per_million.description: US dollars per million tokens, as a number or a decimal string.

NewRule.description: A rule as the API takes it.

key.description:
A fixed key, such as `shop`. Left out, the rule sets the key the
pattern finds: "that feature".

name.description: The name people see, such as `feature key in branch`.

order.description: Lower runs first. Default: after the rules there are.

pattern.description:
A regular expression. A group named `key` picks the tag value's key;
without one, the whole match is the key.

tag_name.description: The tag name the rule sets, such as `feature` or `project`.

NewShare.description: A person's share of a project's plan.

NewSplit.description: A split on a session, or on one message of it.

dated.description:
When the split is dated; default now. Before the cutoff needs
adjust.

message_id.description: Left out, the split is on the whole session.

NewSubmit.description: A new submit: your messages since your last submit.

to.description: The last day to submit, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today.

message.description: A note for the email, such as the month being closed.

until.description: The last day to submit by, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

NewTagValue.description:
A new tag value, or a change to one: a record with the same name and
key supersedes the earlier one.

dated.description:
When the record is dated; default now. Before the cutoff needs
adjust.

oneOf.description:
The tags this value brings, such as `{"client": "acme"}` on a
project. Each must be a value on record.

email.description:
The email of the Atlassian account the token belongs to. Jira Cloud
signs in with both.

site.description: The Jira Cloud site, such as `https://acme.atlassian.net`.

token.description: An API token from the ticket system.

NewTokenEntry.description:
One token entry as it arrives: one message, or one session with its
messages.

agent_harness.description: The product the agent ran on, such as `claude-code` or `support-desk`.

agent_name.description: A label for the agent, such as "review bot".

feature.description: A feature key, such as `KD-214`. Wins over every rule.

local_id.description:
The sender's own id for the entry, such as `claude-code:<session
id>`. Sending it again adds nothing.

messages.description:
The session's model calls. With them, a session that telemetry also
reported is counted exactly once, call by call.

model.description: The model that did the work.

provider.description:
Who charges for the model calls: `anthropic`, `openai`, `google`,
`aws_bedrock`, `gcp_vertex`, `azure_foundry`, `github`, `cursor` or
`other`. Without it, it follows from the model's name.

reported_cost.description:
The agent's own cost figure in US dollars, a fact about the message.
The cost shown is counts × the price table.

session_id.description:
The agent harness's id for the session. Required for a session
record.

signals.description: Facts about the session that rules read.

splits.description:
How the session is split. Without it the session is one split, or
rules split it.

summary.description: What the session did, from one line to a short report.

tags.description: Any other tags, one value per tag name. They win over rules.

tokens.description: Counts by kind. All four kinds; a missing kind is a count error.

cutoff.description:
The cutoff in force: figures up to it are frozen. `null` until an
org manager sets one.

reporting_currency.description:
The one currency figures are shown in, such as `EUR`. The price
table is in US dollars.

sign_in_domains.description: Email domains magic-link sign-in is limited to; empty means any.

OrganizationChange.description: A change to the settings. Fields left out stay as they are.

OrganizationSummary.description: An organization's name and short name.

slug.description: Used in invite links, such as `kestrel` in `/i/kestrel-4f2a9c1e7b03`.

PartInput.description: One part of a split as the API takes and shows it.

fraction.description:
The part's fraction, as a number or a decimal string. The fractions
of a split add up to 1. One part may leave it out: it is 1.

PartState.description: The state of one part, in the words of status.tokencontroller.com.

PartView.description: One part of a message's cost on one tag set.

assigned.description: The split's own tags for this part.

tags.description:
The tags closed under defaults, with the person and their
attributes.

PastWindow.description: One past window of a forecast.

from.description: The first day it holds, or `null` for always.

session_token.description: Once, with `signed_in`: use it as `Authorization: Bearer`.

status.description: `waiting` until the person used the link, then `signed_in`.

PollRequest.description: Collect a local tool's session once its link was used.

PriceRowView.description: One row as the API shows it.

id.description:
The row's event id. An organization's row is reversed by it;
managed rows cannot be reversed.

price_per_million.description: US dollars per million tokens, as a decimal string.

PriceTableView.description: The table as of a moment.

ReconciliationRow.description: One row of the reconciliation table.

ReconciliationView.description:
One bill next to the cost of its provider's messages in its range, in
the core's currency (USD).

bill.description:
The bill, converted at its exchange rate when it is in another
currency.

count_errors.description:
Messages in the range with no counts; their cost is not in
`messages`.

messages.description: The cost of every message of the provider in the range.

unexplained.description:
What the bill has that no message explains. Negative means a
message is wrong.

unknown_models.description: Models in the range with no price row, as `provider/model`.

dated.description:
When the reversal is dated. Default now. A date before the cutoff
needs adjust.

event_id.description: The id of the event to reverse.

RowProblem.description: What a preview shows per row.

RuleView.description: A rule as the API shows it.

id.description: The rule's event id; reverse it to remove the rule.

ServiceStatus.description: The answer of the status endpoint.

status.description: The worst state of any running part.

SessionList.description: A session list with its as-of moment.

SessionView.description: One session: its messages added up.

cost.description: The cost of every priced message, in US dollars.

parts.description: Cost by tag set, the session's splits added up.

ShareView.description: A share as the API shows it.

over.description:
The sum of the project's shares on the share's first day, where it
is over 1. Shown, never corrected.

SignInProvider.description:
A way to sign in besides the magic link, such as the Enterprise plan's
OIDC.

label.description: The label on the sign-in button.

local_tool.description:
`true` for a local tool such as `tc connect`: the answer then carries
a poll token to collect the session with.

SignUpLink.description: The address a sign-up link was sent to.

SignUpRequest.description: Create an organization: the link signs in its first org manager.

SignUpWithLink.description: Create an organization with the link from the "no account" mail.

Signals.description: Facts about a session that rules read. Signals are not tags.

config.description: Values from the repository's `.tokencontroller.toml`, by name.

keys.description:
Keys found in prompts, the session title and the pull request
title, such as `KD-214`. Only the keys, never the text.

SplitView.description: A split as the API shows it.

supersedes.description: The split this one superseded, if any.

StoredEntries.description: What storing gave: one result per token entry sent, in the same shape.

StoredEntry.description: What the sender gets back for one token entry.

cost.description: `C(e)` summed over the entry's messages, as of now, in US dollars.

label.description:
The label of the entry's largest part: `direct`, `project_overhead`
or `organization_overhead`.

messages.description: How many messages the entry stands for.

session_id.description: The session the messages were counted under.

unknown_tags.description:
Tags the entry named that are no value on record, as `name: key`.
They count as sent; add the values to see them in autocomplete.

SubmissionView.description: A submission as the API shows it.

messages.description: The person's messages inside the window.

SubmitRequestView.description: A request to everyone to submit by a day.

done.description: Whether you have submitted up to the request's day.

Submitted.description: Where a message stands in submit and approval.

TagNameView.description: A tag name with its values.

built_in.description: `project`, `feature` and `client` are built in and stay.

values.description: The values on record that the caller may view, by key.

TagValueView.description: One tag value as the API shows it.

defaults.description: The tags this value brings with it, such as `{"project": "shop"}`.

id.description: The event id of the record; reverse it to retire the value.

key.description: The short name used in tags, such as `KD-214` or `shop`.

source_id.description: The id in the ticket system that owns it, such as a Jira issue id.

source_status.description: The status in the ticket system, such as `done`.

Tags.description:
Tags as the OpenAPI document shows the core's [`Tags`]: a JSON object
of tag name to tag value.

TicketSystem.description: The ticket systems tickets sync from.

TicketSystemView.description:
A connected ticket system, as the web app shows it. The token is never
sent back.

key_hint.description: The token's last characters, to tell tokens apart.

mappings.description: The sync map: which of its projects feed which project tag value.

TokenEntries.description: One token entry, or a list of them.

TokensInput.description:
Token counts by kind as they arrive. All four kinds are required; an
entry missing one has no counts and is a count error, never zero.

bearer.description: A CLI token from `tc connect` (`tc_cli_`) or an API token: `tc_svc_` for services, `tc_read_` to read, `tc_org_` for the organization.

session.name: tc_session
session.description: The web app's session, set when a magic link is used in the browser.
